title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring that does not contain any repeating characters. A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters within a string.
exampleOutput:
Example 1: 3 (The substring is "abc")
Example 2: 1 (The substring is "b")
Example 3: 3 (The substring is "wke". Note that "pwke" is a subsequence, not a substring).

title: Container With Most Water
description: You are given an integer array `height` of length `n`. There are `n` vertical lines drawn such that the two endpoints of the `i-th` line are `(i, 0)` and `(i, height[i])`. Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water. Return the maximum amount of water a container can store.
exampleOutput:
49

Explanation: The two lines that form the container with the maximum area are at index 1 (height 8) and index 8 (height 7). The width is (8 - 1) = 7. The height is limited by the shorter line, which is 7. The area is 7 * 7 = 49.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `k`, return the total number of continuous subarrays whose sum equals to `k`. A subarray is a contiguous part of an array. The array can contain positive, negative, and zero values.
exampleInput:
Example 1: nums = [1, 1, 1], k = 2
Example 2: nums = [1, 2, 3], k = 3
exampleOutput:
Example 1: 2 (The subarrays are [1, 1] and [1, 1])
Example 2: 2 (The subarrays are [1, 2] and [3])
